decisions.statement: A search reaching a nested table searches that table too.
A search asked for keys searches the keys rather than the values.
A copy has the metatable of every table copied.
A printed key that is no number is wrapped in quotes.
A sort orders rows of equal width by one column of numbers.
A sort hands back a copy where the rows are ragged.
A sort hands back a copy where a row has a nested table.
A reset keeps the shape of the table handed in.
A reset puts a stated value at every leaf.
A reset by type chooses the value from the Lua type of the leaf.
A helper handed nothing answers as though handed an empty table.

definition: searching, copying, printing, sorting and resetting a Lua table
